summary_1line: Myths recount Udbhata’s divine mission and self‑sacrifice, the miraculous devotion of Kinnera Brahmayya, and the early trials of the pious Mallamma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Udbhata sits in deep yogic posture as his life breath rises from his head while smoke from his funeral pyre frees the cursed sprites in the banyan tree.
Brahmayya seizes the lover’s blade inside the temple and with one stroke sends the man’s head flying before the shrine of Tripurantaka.
Mallamma collapses beside a grinding stone with blistered fingers as Lord Mallikarjuna invisibly finishes grinding the corn for her.
